description: This file defines a Flutter widget called HelpPage, which displays instructions and accessibility notes for a Tic-Tac-Toe game. It imports Flutter material package and project-specific theme and string resources, and builds a stateless widget that presents a styled help interface.

classes.name: HelpPage
classes.description: A stateless widget providing a help and instructions UI for the game.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the help page, assembling app bar and body with instructions.
